title: Unregistered vehicle
text: Driving, moving, parking, or leaving a motor vehicle on a highway or public parking area without current valid registration.

title: Evade peace officer
text: Willfully fleeing or attempting to elude a pursuing peace officer in a marked vehicle with red lamp and siren activated while the officer is in uniform.

title: Evade peace officer with reckless driving
text: Committing VC 2800.1 while driving with willful or wanton disregard for the safety of persons or property.

title: Evade peace officer causing serious injury
text: Violating VC 2800.1 or VC 2800.2 and proximately causing serious bodily injury to another person.

title: Evade peace officer causing death
text: Violating VC 2800.1 or VC 2800.2 and proximately causing the death of another person.

title: Evade officer driving opposite traffic flow
text: While fleeing a pursuing peace officer, driving a vehicle against the lawful direction of traffic.

title: Unsafe load
text: Driving or moving a vehicle with an unsafe or unsecured load likely to spill, drop, blow, or endanger roadway users.

title: Obscure license plate
text: Placing or using any covering, coating, device, or material that obstructs, impairs, or defeats clear recognition of a license plate.

title: False report of vehicle theft
text: Knowingly making a false report to law enforcement that a vehicle has been stolen or embezzled.

title: Vehicle theft
text: Driving or taking a vehicle without the owner's consent, with intent to temporarily or permanently deprive the owner of possession or title.

title: Tamper with vehicle
text: Willfully tampering with or injuring a vehicle or its contents without the owner's consent.

title: Unlicensed driver
text: Driving a motor vehicle on a highway without holding a valid California driver license for that class of vehicle.

title: False registration, license plate, placard, or permits
text: Forging, counterfeiting, altering, possessing, displaying, or using false registration documents, plates, placards, stickers, or permits with fraudulent intent.

title: Driver's license not in possession
text: Failure to present a valid driver license upon lawful demand by a peace officer while operating a motor vehicle.

title: Driving privilege suspended or revoked
text: Driving a motor vehicle while driving privilege is suspended or revoked, with knowledge of the suspension or revocation.

title: Driving privilege suspended or revoked with bodily injury
text: Driving with a DUI-related suspension or revocation and concurrently committing a moving violation that causes bodily injury to another person.

title: Hit and run with injury or death
text: Being involved in an accident causing injury or death and willfully failing to stop and perform the required identification and aid duties.

title: Accident with vehicle or property damage
text: Being involved in an accident causing property damage only and failing to immediately stop and provide required identifying information.

title: Bicyclist on roadway
text: A bicyclist moving slower than normal traffic must ride as close as practicable to the right curb or edge, except statutory exceptions.

title: Unsafe lane change
text: Moving from a lane without first determining that the movement can be made with reasonable safety.

title: Interfere with driver's control of vehicle
text: Interfering with or obstructing the driver's control of a vehicle while the vehicle is in operation.

title: Following too closely
text: Following another vehicle more closely than is reasonable and prudent for speed, traffic, and roadway conditions.

title: Overtaking and passing
text: Passing another vehicle on the left only when safe and returning to the right side only after safely clear of the overtaken vehicle.

title: Jaywalking
text: Crossing a roadway between adjacent intersections controlled by traffic signals outside of a marked crosswalk.

title: Hitchhiking on roadway
text: Standing in a roadway to solicit a ride, business, or employment from an occupant of any vehicle.

title: Stopping suddenly
text: Stopping or suddenly decreasing speed without first giving an appropriate signal when there is opportunity to do so safely.

title: Excessive speed
text: Driving at a speed in excess of the maximum speed permitted by statute or posted lawful limit.

title: Reckless driving
text: Driving a vehicle on a highway in willful or wanton disregard for the safety of persons or property.

title: Reckless driving and bodily injury
text: Committing reckless driving and thereby proximately causing bodily injury to a person other than the driver.

title: Throw substance at vehicle
text: Throwing any substance or object at a vehicle or at an occupant of a vehicle on a highway.

title: Wireless telephone use while driving
text: Driving while using a handheld wireless telephone, except for lawful emergency use or authorized hands-free operation.

title: DUI
text: Driving a vehicle while under the influence of alcohol, drugs, or a combination that impairs the ability to drive with ordinary care.

title: DUI 0.08% BAC or more
text: Driving a vehicle with 0.08 percent or more blood alcohol concentration.

title: DUI with injury
text: Driving under the influence and, while doing so, committing an unlawful act or neglecting a lawful duty, which proximately causes bodily injury.

title: DUI 0.08% BAC or more with injury
text: Driving with 0.08 percent or more blood alcohol concentration and committing an unlawful act or negligence that proximately causes bodily injury.

title: Open container or cannabis
text: Driving while carrying an open container of alcohol or possessing usable cannabis in a motor vehicle as prohibited by statute.

title: Material obstructing driver's view
text: Driving with any object or material placed, displayed, installed, affixed, or applied that obstructs or reduces the driver's clear view.

title: Exhaust system modification
text: Operating a vehicle with an altered or modified exhaust system that increases noise beyond legal limits or bypasses required muffler function.

title: Seat belt violation
text: Driver and passengers failing to wear a properly adjusted and fastened safety belt when required.

title: Child seat restraint under age 8
text: Transporting a child under 8 years old without securing the child in an appropriate child passenger restraint system as required.

title: Child seat restraint age 8 or older
text: Failing to properly restrain a child 8 years or older (or meeting height criteria) with a safety belt or required restraint system.
